entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Steve. How can I help you today?
Hi Steve. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
Okay, certainly. I can help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Dr. Aris Thorne, and the order number is VF7781-PULSE.
Thank you, Dr. Thorne. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered about 44 days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. Is that going to be an issue?
No, that's no problem at all. Our return policy is good for 90 days, so you're well within the window. I can email you a prepaid return label right now.
Oh, wonderful! I wasn't sure what the policy was. Thank you, that's very easy.
It's my pleasure. And I see you're one of our VIP members, Dr. Thorne. As a thank you for your loyalty to VeloFit, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase.
You really didn't have to do that, but thank you very much, Steve! I appreciate it.

You're very welcome. The email with the return label is on its way. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
